title: The Regular meeting of the club
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：regular　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 regular 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the cook wrote of ① a regular meeting of the club in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② more regular than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the regular ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most regular meeting of the club anybody in the canteen had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1962 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too regular to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the regular ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a regular habit of the old man, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as regular as the habit of the old man they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was regular or not, and he said so.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something regular, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite regular; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the regular ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978, twice over, she wrote of another regular meeting of the club in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more regular than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most regular habit of the old man in the whole canteen, she said in 1980, was the one she could never quite name; the regular ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 定期（前置定语 a regular meeting of the club：1968 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件定期的例会）
B. adj. 定期／规律（比较级 more regular than：文中两处，一处比俱乐部的例会，一处比预想）
C. adj. 定期／规律（最高级 the most regular：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 定期（表语 too regular to do：母亲觉得它太定期，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 规律（前置定语 a regular habit of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩规律的习惯）
F. adj. 规律（同级比较 as regular as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人规律的习惯相比）
G. adj. 规律（后置定语 something regular：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 规律（受程度副词修饰 quite regular：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a regular meeting of the club
the most regular meeting of the club anybody
a regular habit of the old man
The most regular habit of the old man in

answers.why: regular 意为“定期”，1968 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件定期的例会”，此处作前置定语 a regular meeting of the club。
regular 意为“定期”，此处用比较级 more regular than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
regular 意为“定期”，菜单上 九月 那行字说它是食堂里最定期的一件，故用最高级 the most regular meeting of the club。
regular 意为“定期”，母亲认为这件东西“太定期了，谁也用不上”，too regular to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
regular 意为“规律”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩规律的习惯”，此处作前置定语 a regular habit of the old man。
regular 意为“规律”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人规律的习惯一样规律”，同级比较用 as regular as。
regular 意为“规律”，菜单上那半行字要的是“规律的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something regular。
regular 意为“规律”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当规律”，quite 修饰原级 regular。
regular 意为“规律”，1978 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要规律”，故用比较级 more regular than。
regular 意为“规律”，母亲 1980 年说的是“整个食堂里最规律的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most regular habit of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件定期的例会。（a regular meeting of the club）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更定期。（more regular than …）
母亲觉得它太定期，谁也用不上。（too regular to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩规律的习惯。（a regular habit of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人规律的习惯一样规律。（as regular as …）
到了 1975 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件规律的东西。（something regular）
answers: In 1968 the cook wrote of a regular meeting of the club in the menu.
Everybody said it was more regular than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too regular to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a regular habit of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as regular as the habit of the old man they had once had.
By 1975 the menu asked for nothing but something regular.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 regular 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the cook wrote of a regular meeting of the club in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most regular meeting of the club in the canteen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too regular to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a regular habit of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite regular, and everybody laughed.
The regular ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
